author: Bellular News
description:
EA removed player options, added paid progression worth around $100, and then backed down when players revolted. The payments are gone, but the missing options have not returned.

More importantly, insiders say this was part of a wider push to find new ways to monetise EA’s games, including future single-player releases, as the company faces $20 billion in acquisition debt.
